Storyboard Studio

API key set nahi hai ▾
GEMINI API KEY
MODEL

Key sirf is session mein memory mein rehti hai, kahin save nahi hoti. Free key: aistudio.google.com/apikey. Ek model ki limit khatam ho ya error aaye to yahan se foran doosra chun lein.

Idea se locked-character storyboard tak — chhoti animation se le kar lambi animated film ya episodic series tak, sequence-wise, jitni chahein utni scenes, bina repeat kiye.

🎛️ MODE ENGINE — PRODUCTION MODE · ASPECT RATIO · FILE NAMING · CHARACTER IDs
Mode chunein — style, lighting, pacing, calm, aerab aur us mode ke rules ek click mein lag jayenge. Kuch na chunein to app pehle jaisi hi chalti hai.
STORY IDEA
API key ho to AI kahani ke mutabiq hook likhta hai; key na ho to app kahani ke aage ke ek dilchasp manzar se khud teaser banati hai. Hook add hone par baqi scenes ke number 1 aage shift ho jate hain.
ON: Scene 1 ek powerful 8-10 second (aap chunein) teaser hook hoga (kahani ki jhalak, spoiler nahi) aur asal kahani Scene 2 se shuru hogi. OFF: koi hook nahi — story seedha Scene 1 se shuru. Pehle se bane storyboard par toggle badalne se hook scene add / remove ho jata hai, aur export mein wahi dikhta hai.
🧭 SUGGESTION & GUIDE — kis video ke liye kaunsa style, lighting aur preset?
📖 STEP 1 — MUKAMMAL URDU KAHANI (parh kar approve karein) → STEP 2 — STORYBOARD
Upar Story Idea likhein, phir yahan AI se khoobsurat Urdu kahani likhwayein. Aap use parh kar khud edit kar sakte hain ya "Tabdeeli" likh kar dobara likhwa sakte hain. Approve karne ke baad hi storyboard (Character DNA, Locations, Props, Scene prompts) isi kahani se banega.
🎭 KAHANI KA ANDAZ — poori kahani kis mizaj mein likhi jaye
Koi andaz nahi chuna — kahani apne normal andaz mein banegi. Ek chunein (dobara dabane se hat jata hai).
🧭 STORY COMPASS — kahani ke saath hi "aage kya ho sakta hai"
Aage ka andaz chunein (ek ya zyada):
Chuna hua idea (✓ Active) pehle Sequence mein bhi AI ko jata hai aur agle Sequences / Auto-continue mein bhi follow hota hai. Idea ke bina sirf andaz chunein to bhi AI usi mizaj mein kahani chalata hai. Story ka text kabhi nahi badalta.
🧠 STORY LOGIC LOCK — kahani ke asal facts / physics (har batch mein AI ko jate hain)

      

      

      
Kyun zaroori: naye batch ko AI sirf pichle scenes ki "action" dekhta hai, kahani ka asal tareeqa (jaise "kankar matke mein dalne se paani upar uthta hai") nahi — isi liye pehla batch theek aur baad ke batch ghalat hote the. Yahan likhe facts har batch ke sath bheje jate hain. Pehle "AI se meri story ka matlab + facts" dabayein, padhein ke AI ne kahani sahi samjhi ya nahi, galat facts hata dein — phir hi wo lock honge. App khud kabhi koi fact nahi bharti.

    

    

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
        
      

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
        

      

      

        
        

          
          
        

        

          
          
          
          
          
        

        

      

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
        

      

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
        
        
      

    

    
Pacing profile (Kids Cartoon / Islamic-Educational / Cinematic) har scene ke duration ke hisaab se speech rate, dialogue ka lead-in aur tail, beat plan (kitne beats, kab dialogue shuru/khatam), camera-cut rules aur AI video generator ka pacing text tay karta hai — ye sab export prompt mein "Pacing & Timing" block ban kar jata hai aur auto-fit duration bhi isi se nikalta hai. Manual override hamesha auto-fit par ghalib rehta hai.

    
Lighting preset library se chuna hua preset poore project ke har scene ke style block, export prompt aur Compact Prompt mein lagta hai. Kisi ek scene ke card mein "Scene Lighting & Mood" se us scene ke liye alag preset bhi chun sakte hain (wo global lighting par ghalib rehta hai). Har scene card mein Shot type, Angle, Movement aur Lens ke dropdowns milkar final camera direction banate hain.

    
Visual Style Preset badalte hi "Style tags" field automatically us style ke cinematic keywords se bhar jata hai — ye poore project ke har scene (naya Sequence, regenerate, export) ke prompt mein automatically apply hota hai.

    
Auto-fit ON ho to har scene ka duration uske Urdu dialogue ke huroof ÷ speech rate se khud barh jata hai (3s se le kar 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10s ... "Max auto-fit duration" tak — koi bhi poora second) aur start/end time (SRT/CSV/PDF) sab scenes ke liye dobara calculate ho jata hai. Kisi scene ke card mein "Scene Duration" dropdown se manual duration bhi set kar sakte hain (manual hamesha auto-fit par ghalib rehta hai).

AUTO-SAVE & BACKUP

    

      💾 Auto-save tayyar hai
      
      
      
      
    

    
Har tabdeeli par poora project (story, characters, locations, props, scenes, settings) browser ke local storage mein khud save hota hai aur page dobara kholne par wapas aa jata hai. API key kabhi save nahi hoti. Browser data clear hone ya doosre device ke liye "Export JSON" se backup rakhein, aur "Import JSON" se wapas load karein.

  


  

    
🎙️ NARRATOR VOICEOVER (OPTIONAL)

    
    

      
      
    

    
Band (default) ho to narrator ke bagair hi scenes banenge. Chahein to har scene ke card mein akele us scene ka narrator on/off kar sakte hain, text edit kar sakte hain, ya sirf usi scene ki narration dobara generate kar sakte hain. Narration hamesha wahi bayan karti hai jo us scene mein dikh raha hai.

  


  

    
🌙 GLOBAL ATMOSPHERE & NIGHT CONTINUITY LOCK

    
    
    

    
    
    
Auto mein Pixar style: Bright Pixar Educational, Wildlife, Botanical, Microscopic, Deep Sea, Deep Space, Arctic. Natural style: Ancient, Shipwreck, Volcanic, Storm, Cyberpunk, Anatomy, Noir, Quantum, Moral Story / Dastan (oil-painting storybook look), 3D Scientific Macro Explainer (hyper-real CGI), Historical Scientist Biographies (vintage documentary), Step-by-Step Mechanism & Physics Lab (clean 3D technical), Interactive Infographic & Data Viz (flat-vector motion graphics), Emotional & Moral Storytelling (painterly lantern-lit look), Sci-Fi Cosmic Odyssey, Dark Fantasy / Gothic Mystery, Ancient Archaeological Epic aur Modern Minimalist Explainer 3D (cinematic ya clean explainer look). Bina preset wale scenes mein aapka apna Visual Style hi chalta hai.

    
    
    
Ye poore project ka waqt/mausam/roshni ka mahaul har scene ke prompt mein lazmi lagta hai. Khaali chhodein to pehli Sequence generate hote hi story se khud bhar jata hai. Raat lock ho to daylight/sunlight wale alfaz lighting aur visual notes se khud hat jate hain aur negative prompt mein daytime block ho jata hai. Waqt sirf tab badlta hai jab kisi scene ke card mein "Atmosphere / Time Transition" khud likha jaye (wo agle scenes tak chalta hai). Koi bhi Atmosphere Preset (26 styles: Emotional & Moral Storytelling, Interactive Infographic & Data Viz, Historical Scientist Biographies, Step-by-Step Mechanism Lab, 3D Scientific Macro Explainer, Educational, Documentary, Moral Story / Dastan, Sci-Fi Cosmic, Gothic Mystery, Archaeological Epic, Minimalist Explainer) chunne par uski lighting hard-lock ho jati hai, enforced tags har prompt mein lagte hain, aur doosre presets ki conflicting roshni (jaise deep sea/space mein sunlight/daylight) hat jati hai.

  


  

    
🕊️ STRESS-FREE & CALM AUDIO-VISUAL ENFORCER

    
    
    
    
    
    
On rehne par har scene ke prompt mein slow/smooth camera lock lagta hai (whip pan, crash zoom, handheld shake, tez cuts khud naram ho jate hain), negative prompt mein jerky/flicker blockers judte hain, aur har export block mein peaceful audio direction aati hai (setting ke mutabiq: deep-sea hums, soft cosmic drone, room-tone wagaira). Harsh SFX alfaz (explosion, siren, scream, thunder clap) export mein khud naram ho jate hain; aapka saved SFX text wahi rehta hai. Ye Atmosphere preset ki lighting lock ke saath mil kar kaam karta hai — roshni ka source preset hi tay karta hai.

  


  

    
🔬 SCIENTIFIC LABELLING & HUD OVERLAY

    
    
    
    
    
Auto mode scene ke action / visual notes / scene type mein invention, machine, engine, circuit, experiment, lab, blueprint jaise alfaz (aur ایجاد، مشین، تجربہ جیسے Urdu alfaz) dhoondta hai. Milne par export prompt mein HUD tags lag jate hain aur negative prompt se "text overlay" jaise overlay-blockers hat jate hain. Har scene card mein apna Auto / ON / OFF switch bhi hai.

🎯 STORY BEATS — CURIOSITY, TWIST, CLIMAX

    
    
    
    
    
    

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
      

    

    

    

    

      
      
    

    

    
Ye sab Pixar, Ghibli, Noir, Cyberpunk, Documentary... har style preset ke upar overlay ki tarah lagta hai — style, Character DNA, libaas aur Atmosphere lock jaise ke taise rehte hain. Har scene ke prompt ke aakhir mein ek chhota "Creative Direction" block judta hai (Slideshow mein bhi, bina camera-motion ke); AI se naya Sequence / scene regenerate karte waqt wahi choices (genre, mood, cast, beats) AI ko bhi bheji jati hain. Story Beats ke liye "Target scenes" tay karein to beats ki exact scene-jagah milti hai; warna AI ko batch-by-batch hidayat jati hai ke twist / climax abhi na khatam kare. Calm mode ya Kids / Islamic pacing ON ho to horror / thriller / anger khud narm kar diye jate hain. Har scene card mein beat aur expression alag se badal sakte hain. Default mein sab band hai.

  


  

    
NEGATIVE PROMPT — EXCLUSIONS (poori story ke liye default)

    
    
Ye har scene ke export mein automatically shamil hota hai. Kisi scene ke card mein alag se likh kar sirf usi scene ke liye override kar sakte hain.

  


  

    
MASTER INSTRUCTIONS — GLOBAL (OPTIONAL)

Change karne ke baad turant agle batch/regenerate se apply ho jata hai — dobara "Start storyboard" dabane ki zaroorat nahi.

PROMPT LENGTH CHECKER — SAB SCENES

        

      

    

    

      
      
      
    

    

      
      

      

    

    
Har scene ke card mein selected platform ke hisaab se final prompt ki live length dikhti hai: Green = safe (yellow limit tak), Yellow = lamba, Red = bohot lamba. Limits khud badal sakte hain. Prompt lamba ho to "⚡ Compact Prompt" ek click mein sirf zaroori Character DNA, Style, Lighting aur core action rakh kar chhota version bana deta hai (original data nahi badalta, kabhi bhi full wapas la sakte hain).

    
Sora/Luma dialogue lipsync ko exact follow nahi karte, aur Sora/Luma negative prompt bhi support nahi karte — export unhi limitations ke mutabiq adjust ho jata hai. "Auto-continue" ke saamne wala number batao kitne naye Sequences lagataar (bina baar-baar click kiye) generate karne hain — beech mein rokne ke liye dobara button dabayein.

  


  

    
🎬 10 / 20-BLOCKS MASTER PROMPT FORMAT

    
    
    

    
Blocks 1–10: Scene Type · Subject · Appearance (locked DNA) · Setting & Lighting · Action · Timing split · Dialogue (sirf ek baar) · Camera · Audio · Negatives. 20-Blocks mein ye bhi: 11 Color Grading · 12 Lighting Intensity · 13 Micro-Expressions · 14 Atmosphere Density · 15 Lens & Focal Length · 16 Background Physics · 17 Dialogue Emotion & Rhythm · 18 Room Tone · 19 Visual Continuity Bridge · 20 Family-Friendly Filter. Characters (@tags), location, timing, dialogue aur audio scene ke apne data se khud bharte hain. Lantern logic: golden hour / din ke scenes mein haath khaali aur lantern bilkul nahi; lantern sirf twilight / evening / night mein aur jalta hua. Is mode mein "Visual Style" field prompt mein nahi jata — look Block 1 ka text decide karta hai.

🎞️ FRAME-TO-FRAME / SHOT BREAKDOWN GUIDE

    
    

      

        
        
      

    

    
Ye guide purane prompt (20-Blocks, Character DNA, Atmosphere / Night lock, Calm lock, HUD) ko bilkul nahi chhedta — wo jaisa tha waisa rehta hai; sirf uske neeche ek alag "FRAME-TO-FRAME SHOT BREAKDOWN" block add hota hai. Frames scene ke action text se khud (offline, bina API call ke) banate hain: Frame 1 = Shuruaat, aakhri frames = Impact aur Reaction. Har frame pichle frame ke aakhri pose/position/camera se shuru hota hai (koi teleport ya jump nahi), aur har scene ka Visual Bridge pehle frame ko pichle scene se jodta hai. Har scene card mein "🎞️ Frame-to-Frame breakdown" se us scene ke frames dekh sakte hain, count badal sakte hain, ya "✨ AI se refine" se behtar frames likhwa sakte hain. Slideshow (static image) mode mein ye guide band rehta hai kyunke wahan har scene ek hi image hai.

    

      
      
      
      
    

    

  


  

    
🗣️ AUTO-DIALOGUE LIP-SYNC CUE TOOL

    
Pehle storyboard generate karein.

    

      

        
        
      

    

    
    
Dialogue ke huroof ÷ "Urdu speech rate" (aur Pacing profile ka lead-in / tail) se hisaab lagata hai ke bolna kab shuru aur khatam hoga, aur scene ke duration mein fit hai ya nahi. Video mode mein ye lips (mouth-movement) ki timing hai; Slideshow mode mein har slide par voiceover ka fit (kyunke static image mein lips nahi hilte). Narrator wali voiceover bhi isi hisaab mein shamil hai (wo lips nahi hilati, sirf audio). Har scene card mein bhi ek chhota Lip-Sync check hai jahan se duration ±1s ya "fit" ek click mein ho jata hai.

    

      
      
      
      
    

    

  


  

    
🔒 CLIP LENGTH LOCK (8s / 10s) + LAMBE DIALOGUE KA HAL

    
Pehle storyboard generate karein.

    

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
      

    

    
    

    
    
    
    

      
      
      
      
      
    

    

    
Kaise kaam karta hai: (1) Lock ON karte hi base duration aur "Max auto-fit" usi length par aa jate hain, aur naye scenes ke prompt mein kul dialogue + narration ki huroof-limit likh di jati hai. (2) Jahan bolna clip se lamba hai wahan 🤖 AI chhota (matlab wahi, alfaz kam) ya ✂ Split chuniye — Split bade jumle ko pehle jumle ki hadd par, phir comma par, aakhir mein alfaz par todta hai aur agla hissa agle scene mein "seedha continuation" ke saath chala jata hai (scene numbers khud aage ho jate hain). (3) 🪄 Smart Fix pehle AI se chhota karta hai, jo phir bhi lamba rahe usay Split karta hai. Intro Hook scene ko ye tool nahi chhedta. Har kaam ke baad ↩ Undo se pichli halat wapas aa jati hai.

  


  

    
🎙 VOICE DIRECTOR — Flow / Veo ko awaaz ki hidayat (kahani / documentary ke hisaab se)

    
Veo mein alag "voice" field nahi hota — awaaz sirf prompt ke alfaz se control hoti hai. Ye tool har scene ke copy-prompt mein awaaz ki hidayat judta hai (jin scenes mein dialogue / narration ho). Research ke mutabiq awaaz ki tafseel har clip mein ek hi jaisi (alfaz ba alfaz) honi chahiye, isliye yahan ek baar set karein.

    
    

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
      

    

    

      

        
        
      

    

    
Dheemi / Normal / Tez chunte hi "Bolne ki raftaar" (Clip Length panel) bhi usi ke hisaab se 10 / 11 / 13 huroof per second ho jati hai, taake dheemi awaaz ke liye dialogue ki limit khud kam ho jaye. Auto mein limit nahi badalti.

    
CHARACTER AWAAZEN (har clip mein ek jaisi)

    

    
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
      
    
    
    
    
    
    
⚡ VOICE PRESETS (ek click mein set)

    

      
      
      
      
      
      
    

    
Preset Voice Director ON karta hai aur narrator, tone, raftaar, saaf awaaz, saans ka waqfa aur no-subtitles set karta hai (raftaar ke saath Clip limit bhi). Character ki awaazen aur accent line nahi chhedta. 🧙 Wise / Deep sirf prompt mein tone (lehja) judta hai — dialogue ki huroof limit aur Speech rate ko bilkul nahi chhedta. Natural preset sirf awaaz ki hidayat hai — Veo ki awaaz kitni behtar hogi, iska koi pakka number nahi, 2-3 clips mein khud dekhein.

    

      
      
    

    

    

      🛠 Flow / Veo ke aam masail aur unka hal (research)
      

        1. Awaaz beech mein kat jati / tez ho jati hai — dialogue clip ke hisaab se chhota rakhein (Clip Length panel). (kai sources)

        2. Har clip mein awaaz alag lagti hai — awaaz ki tafseel har prompt mein alfaz ba alfaz ek jaisi rakhein (Voice Director yahi karta hai). (kai sources) Pakka hal: saare clips ki awaaz ek hi voice-changer / TTS (jaise ElevenLabs) se ek jaisi kar dein; Google ke support ne khud kaha ke awaaz ka assignment guaranteed nahi. (ek-do sources)

        3. Screen par ulte seedhe subtitles aa jate hain — "no subtitles" line + negative prompt, aur dialogue chhota rakhein. (kai sources; ek source ke mutabiq dialogue ke quotes bhi sabab ban sakte hain)

        4. Lip-sync kamzor — wide shot mein mooh chhota hota hai, close / medium shot lein; ek clip mein ek hi bolne wala. (kai sources) Google khud kehta hai ke bolti awaaz abhi behtar ho rahi hai.

        5. Urdu uchcharan / accent — Veo ke docs mein English fully supported hai, baqi zubanein evaluate nahi hui. Ek user ke test mein halka waqfa + pur-sukoon raftaar se behtar aaya, lekin "native accent" likhne se bigad gaya. (sirf ek test) Pakka hal: alag TTS + lip-sync pass.

        6. Chehra / kapde clip badalte hi badal jate hain — har clip ki starting image / reference image aur wahi character description. (kai sources)

        ⚠ Ye sab online guides aur users ke tajurbe hain, Google ki guarantee nahi — mujhe pata nahi ke har case mein sahi nikalenge. Apne clips par 2-3 dafa test karke dekhein.

Upar ke quick buttons ek click mein poori timeline (ya chuni hui scene range) par lagte hain. Storyboard banne ke baad yahan har scene ka prop status dikhega.

  

  

    
🔁 QUICK ACTION / PROP SWAPPER

    
Pehle storyboard generate karein.

    

      

        
        
        
      

      

        
        
        
        
      

    

    

      

        
        
      

      

        
        
      

    

    
    

      
      
      
    

    

    
Ye sirf chune hue scenes ke Action, Visual notes, Visual bridge aur Camera text mein purane prop ka naam naye naam se badalta hai (a/an, plural aur capital letters khud theek karta hai) — poora prompt dobara likhne ki zaroorat nahi. Cast header aur @tags khud naye prop ke mutabiq ho jate hain; agar naya prop locked sheet mein hai to uski design bhi har prompt mein lock rehti hai. Scene card ke andar bhi "Prop Swapper" hai: prop par click karein, phir naya prop chunein — ek hi scene (aur uske agle scene ka bridge) badalta hai. Character DNA, Atmosphere, Frame-to-Frame aur baqi systems ko haath nahi lagta; har swap Undo ho sakta hai. Video aur Slideshow dono mein kaam karta hai.

  


  

    
🔊 SMART SOUND FX MATCHER

    
Pehle storyboard generate karein.

    

      

        
        
      

    

    
    
    

      
      
      
      
      
      
    

    

    
Har scene ka mood (tension, udaasi, khushi, adventure, sukoon, hairat...), action, location, raat/din atmosphere aur scene type dekh kar ambient awaaz, action ke foley SFX (video mein frame ke waqt ke saath) aur BGM suggest karta hai — bina API call ke, foran. Lagataar scenes ka mood same ho to BGM bhi wahi rehta hai (har scene par track nahi badalta). Pacing profile (Kids / Islamic / Cinematic), Calm mode aur "Studio standard note" (jaise "koi background music nahi") ka khayal rakhta hai — Kids/Islamic/Calm mein tez ya darawni awaazein khud nikal jati hain. "Apply" sirf scene ki maujooda "Ambient / Cinematic SFX / BGM" field bharta hai jo pehle se prompts mein jati hai; purani field Undo se wapas aa sakti hai. Slideshow mein static image ke liye ambience + BGM + sirf 2 accent sounds aur editor ke liye time-wali Cue sheet milti hai. Existing "🔊 Auto-generate" (AI) jaisa tha waisa hi hai.

  


  

    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
    
  

  


  

    
VOICE STUDIO — URDU AERAB (اعراب) · SPEAKER-WISE EXPORT · STYLE SYNC · STORY POLISH

    

      

        
        

      

      

        
      

      

        
        
        
Asli dialogue kabhi nahi badalta (duration, huroof aur SRT waise hi rehte hain) — aerab alag save hota hai. Neeche "AI se aerab lagayein" se poora aerab lagta hai; bina AI ke sirf aam alfaz ka offline aerab lagta hai.

      

    

    

        
    

    

      
      
      
      
      
    

    

    
SPEAKER-WISE VOICE EXPORT (Narrator + har character alag)

    

      
      
      
    

    

    
🔊 GEMINI VOICE PIPELINE — har scene ki awaaz (WAV) ek ZIP mein

    

      

      

      

    

    

      
      
    

    
Format WAV hai (MP3 ke liye alag encoder chahiye jo offline nahi chalta; WAV har editor mein khulta hai). Pehle se bani awaaz (animatic) dobara use hoti hai. Gemini key chahiye.

    

    
Speaker kaise pehchana jata hai: agar dialogue mein "Naam: jumla" likha ho to wahi; warna scene mein sirf ek character ho to wahi bolne wala; kai characters hon to scene card ke "Voice & Aerab" box mein speaker chunein (warna wo "UNASSIGNED" section mein aata hai). Narrator ka alag section hamesha banta hai.

  


  

    
📺 YOUTUBE PACK — TITLE, DESCRIPTION, HASHTAGS & 3D THUMBNAIL PROMPT

    
Poori story, locked characters (@tags), locations aur scenes padh kar AI Urdu + English title, SEO description, hashtags aur thumbnail prompt banata hai. Thumbnail prompt mein character ka locked DNA aur project ka style/lighting khud judta hai, taake shakal story se match kare. Sab fields edit ho sakti hain.

🎯 TITLE — ENGLISH

      
📝 DESCRIPTION (SEO)

      
# HASHTAGS
YouTube title ke upar sirf pehle 3 hashtags dikhata hai — sabse zaroori pehle rakhein.

      
🖼️ 3D THUMBNAIL PROMPT

    

  


  

    
STORY EXPANDER — AI PLOT TWIST SUGGESTIONS

    
AI ne ab tak ki kahani analyze karke ye directions suggest ki hain. Jo pasand aaye us par "Is direction ko use karein" dabayein — agla Sequence (ya Auto-continue) isi guidance ke mutabiq generate hoga.

    

    

      
    

  


  

    
AI STORY CONTINUITY SCAN — REPORT

    
Saari scenes ek saath, poori kahani ki tarah, analyze ki gayi hain: logical loops, dohrayi hui actions (jaise baar-baar ghari ya qutb-numa/compass dekhna), location/set contradictions, aur timeline/lighting mismatches. Sirf jin scenes mein wakai masla tha unki action/visual notes/duration adjust hui hai — Character DNA, Atmosphere Lock aur Urdu dialogue/narration bilkul nahi chhue gaye.

    

  


  

    
EXPORTED PROMPTS — COPY & PASTE INTO GOOGLE FLOW

    
    

      
      
    

    

      
📚 COPY IN PARTS — MOBILE PAR BADA COPY FAIL HO TO

      

        

          

      

      

      
Mobile keyboard/clipboard ki limit ki wajah se bohot lamba text copy nahi hota. Yahan har part alag copy hota hai (har scene mein character DNA, style aur atmosphere pehle se shamil hai, is liye kisi bhi part ko akele paste karna safe hai). Ya \"Download .txt\" se poori file save kar lein.

    

  






  

    

    

    

    

      
      
    

  






  
📚 Saved Library & Prompt History

  

    
    
  


  

    
Yahan aap ke apne save kiye hue prompts hain. Ye automatic History se alag hain — khud kabhi delete ya trim nahi hote. Scene card ya History mein "⭐ Save to Library" dabayein.

    

      
      
    

    

      
      
      
      
      
      
      
    

    

      
      
      

    

    

    

  


  

    
Naya Sequence ya scene prompt bante hi yahan khud save ho jata hai (aakhri 300 tak). History is browser ke Local Storage mein hai — usi device par dobara kholne par wapas milti hai. Mobile aur laptop ke beech le jane ke liye "Export JSON" karein, doosre device par "Import JSON".
